queries.result: Official Qingdao/Laixi results evidence Laixi natural-resources and real-estate registration work and a Qingdao municipal registration information service, but the indexed material does not expose a safe anonymous citywide parcel geometry feed.

officialLeads.evidence: Official platform operated by the Shandong Department of Natural Resources / Shandong Institute of Land Surveying and Mapping; landing page advertises a natural-resources channel and public map services, but not a confirmed Laixi parcel layer.
Official API page documents public base/dynamic/feature map services and geocoding/search functions; it does not identify a Laixi cadastral parcel service.

Official Qingdao government report identifies Laixi natural-resources bureau work on rural house-and-land integrated real-estate registration; this establishes local registry activity, not an open geometry API.
Official procurement text lists a cadastral-map public-query system and registration information service, but no public endpoint or anonymous response for Laixi was exposed by the inspected page.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Current JavaScript bootstrap was downloaded; it references Config_url.v002.js and map bundles. The visible layer families are base, imagery, boundaries, roads, POI and natural-resources themes; no parcel schema or Laixi parcel endpoint was found.
Configuration bundle is obfuscated; extracted service hosts include service.sdmap.gov.cn:8081 and public WMTS/base-map routes, but no parcel feature route or safe parcel field schema was identified.
Official API documentation page loaded; it describes base, WMS/WMTS, feature and search services, without a Laixi cadastral layer or bounded ID-plus-geometry response.
Official natural-resources channel loaded; no anonymous parcel geometry response or parcel schema was exposed in the page bootstrap.
Direct ordinary request returned a route/auth error; no TLS bypass, credentials, private token, login, CAPTCHA or Cloudflare workaround was used.
Laixi registration program evidence; no public geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Shandong and Qingdao official sources establish provincial geospatial services and Laixi registration activity, but target-city parcel coverage and an anonymous geometry service were not verified.
coverageAssessment.localRegistryCustodian: Laixi Municipal Natural Resources Bureau is evidenced by official Qingdao material as the local registration/natural-resources actor, but no public parcel service was verified.

blocker: No public, anonymous Laixi parcel service or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
remainingUncertainty: A local or municipal viewer may exist behind an unindexed route or require an ordinary viewer bootstrap. Search absence, API documentation limits, and the 401 route response do not prove citywide cadastral absence. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used for a zero-hit inference.
nextStep: Retry any publicly linked Laixi/Qingdao cadastral viewer when reachable; inspect only its public JavaScript/configuration for geometry-only services and validate CRS, scope, stable native IDs and a small safe response before considering admission.
notes: WUP notes=5; exact coordinate preserved in latitude/longitude order. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe lookup was used.
